content: System Description doesn't use a complete Software Com- ponent Description If the System Description doesn't use a complete Software Component Description (VFB View) the data mapping of VariableDataPrototype s or ArgumentDataPrototype s owned by ClientServerOperation s on System- Signal s does not need to be defined. This supports the inclusion of legacy signals.
